title.narrative: Support to South Africa's Revitalised Response to Health and AIDS

description.narrative: This activity Support to South Africa's Revitalised Response to Health and AIDS is a component of Strengthening South Africa’S Revitalised Response to AIDS and Health (SSARRAH) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £30,987,441. It works in the following sector(s): STD control including HIV/AIDS, Public finance management (PFM), Democratic participation and civil society.
